system_description.narrative_title: Global bond rout and rising yields reprice risk across markets
system_description.narrative_summary: A synchronized repricing of long-term interest rates — driven by stronger growth signals, persistent inflation risks, rising oil prices and shifting central-bank guidance — is triggering a global bond sell-off that is propagating into currencies, equities, commodities and sovereign credit. The system is open: policy decisions, macro data, energy shocks and fiscal financing needs interact through market expectations and liquidity, producing feedbacks (higher yields → asset repricing → fiscal/credit stress → more issuance/flight) that can amplify volatility and contagion across borders and asset classes.
system_description.scope: Global fixed-income markets and their immediate linkages: government and corporate bond yields and spreads, central-bank policy and communications, inflation and growth data, oil and commodity price shocks, investor risk appetite and flows, and near-term impacts on equities, gold and FX.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (monetary policy, fiscal financing, international trade and geopolitics).
adjacent_subsystems: Central banking and monetary policy frameworks
Sovereign fiscal policy and government debt markets
Equities and credit markets (corporate and junk bonds)

variables.name: Long-term nominal yields
variables.description: The market-level interest rate on long-maturity nominal debt instruments, reflecting compensation for time and nominal risk.

variables.name: Real yields
variables.description: The inflation-adjusted return on long-maturity debt, measuring real compensation to investors net of expected inflation.

variables.name: Inflation rate
variables.description: The ongoing rate of change in the general price level across the economy measured over a specified period.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: The market and agent-level expected future path of inflation over relevant horizons.

variables.name: Term premium
variables.description: The compensation investors require for holding longer-maturity nominal bonds versus rolling short-term instruments, beyond expected short rates.

variables.name: Growth expectations
variables.description: The anticipated future trajectory of real economic activity as priced by markets and signaled by macro forecasts.

variables.name: Central bank policy rate
variables.description: The prevailing short-term policy interest rate set to implement monetary policy stance.

variables.name: Central bank forward guidance
variables.description: The ongoing communication process through which monetary authorities shape expectations about future policy and rates.

variables.name: Fiscal financing need
variables.description: The level of public sector borrowing required to cover deficits and scheduled obligations over a fiscal horizon.

variables.name: Sovereign credit spreads
variables.description: The yield premium demanded for sovereign debt versus risk-free benchmarks, representing sovereign credit risk and liquidity premia.

variables.name: Corporate credit spreads
variables.description: The yield premium on corporate bonds over comparable government debt, reflecting corporate default and liquidity risk.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: The prevailing market price of crude oil, capturing energy cost shocks that feed into inflation and trade balances.

variables.name: Market liquidity
variables.description: The ease and cost with which financial assets can be transacted without large price impact across markets.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: The aggregate willingness of investors to hold risky assets versus safe assets, influencing demand and flows.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: The net movement of portfolio and capital between jurisdictions over time, transmitting shocks across markets.

variables.name: Market implied volatility
variables.description: The level of volatility priced into options and derivatives, representing market-implied uncertainty about future asset returns.

catalysts.title: US jobs report (early October)
catalysts.description: Monthly US employment data due in the first week of October that will strongly influence growth, inflation expectations and Treasury yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'jobs data looms', '10-year yield higher as traders... await jobs report' — payrolls will reprice growth/inflation and yields.

catalysts.title: Fed keeps rates on hold in October (guidance)
catalysts.description: Fed officials signalling a pause in October will shape forward guidance and keep short-term policy rates elevated in markets near-term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Top Fed official signals central bank will keep rates on hold in October', 'Fed officials wash away market bets on October rate increase'.

catalysts.title: Risk of Fed rate hike in December
catalysts.description: Market and bank forecasts increasingly price a potential December Fed rate increase, which would lift policy rates and long-term yields.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Goldman Sachs pushes Fed rate hike forecast to December' — markets pricing a December hike that would lift yields and premiums.

catalysts.title: ECB reaction / potential October hikes
catalysts.description: Elevated eurozone inflation and ECB officials' warnings increase odds of ECB tightening, affecting European yields and inflation expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Inflation in Eurozone’s biggest economies reaches multiyear highs', 'ECB ‘cannot wait’... top policymaker warns'.

catalysts.title: Sustained oil-price rise
catalysts.description: Further increases in oil prices driven by geopolitical and demand factors will feed into inflation and higher bond yields globally.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oil price and US Treasury yields in tightest relationship', 'oil jumps', 'Bond sell-off deepens and oil rises as Iran-US deal hopes fade'.

catalysts.title: France 2027 budget tightening process
catalysts.description: Government moves to rein in pensions and state wages for the 2027 budget could change fiscal needs and market perceptions of French sovereign risk.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'France demands belt-tightening in 2027 budget', 'France seeks to rein in pensions and state salaries in 2027'.

catalysts.title: Japan bond market / BOJ policy pivot risk
catalysts.description: Debate inside BOJ and recent intervention pause make Japanese yields a potential trigger for global repricing if yields shift further.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Japan’s Bond Market Could Be the Next Catalyst', 'BOJ debated more rate hikes... summary shows', 'Japan pauses forex intervention'.

catalysts.title: Corporate credit stress and heavy issuance
catalysts.description: Widening junk-bond weakness and large corporate refinancing sales will pressure spreads and liquidity across credit markets.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Junk bonds are heading for worst month since 2022', 'Paramount’s mega debt sale reveals how higher bond yields are squeezing corporate America'.

catalysts.title: US Treasury supply / fiscal financing pressure
catalysts.description: Rising deficits and heavy Treasury issuance needs will keep upward pressure on long-term yields and term premium through Q4.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Rising Deficits and War Unravel Trump's Strategy to Lower Interest Rates', 'U.S. bond yields post biggest jump... rout rattles investors'.

catalysts.title: Implied volatility surge from yield breakout
catalysts.description: As long-term yields hit multi-decade highs, options-implied volatility is likely to spike, affecting liquidity and risk appetite.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: '10-Year Treasury Yield Breakouts as Implied Volatility Surges', 'Bond markets are screaming... every asset class should be listening'.
